rationale.A: Track beside Kipparlahdensilmukka and Itäväylä, then 90 m on Tupasaarentie and quiet Svinhufvudintie; 1 light
rationale.B: Path, then 380 m in mixed traffic on Kulosaaren puistotie (30 km/h); 3 unsignalised minor-arterial crossings; 0 lights
rationale.C: Same streets as A but the track runs right beside Itäväylä (70 km/h) and crosses a trunk-road ramp without signals
rationale.E: Detour via quiet Kulosaari manor road; still 200 m in traffic on Kulosaaren puistotie and the Itäväylä-side track; +5 min
rationale.F: Kipparlahdenraitti and paths, slightly less arterial-side than A; 3 lights; +5 min
rationale.G: Kivinokka detour on a quiet road, but the same 380 m on Kulosaaren puistotie as B; +6 min

notes: Short trip; differences are small. A has only 1 light, so a fewest-lights card can never pay off. No candidate clearly beats A's tier for its 5–6 min detour. Ranking B against A is a judgement call: 380 m in 30 km/h mixed traffic against a longer arterial-side track.
